steps.command:
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
pwd
git status
echo "--- branches ---"
git branch -avv
echo "--- recent reflog ---"
git reflog --date=iso -30
echo "--- stash ---"
git stash list
echo "--- log all ---"
git log --all --oneline --graph --decorate -30
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
ls -la /workspace
echo "--- find git repos ---"
find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -name .git -print 2>/dev/null
find / -maxdepth 3 -name .git -print 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- status ---"
git status
echo "--- branches ---"
git branch -avv
echo "--- reflog ---"
git reflog --date=iso -40
echo "--- stash ---"
git stash list
echo "--- graph all ---"
git log --all --oneline --graph --decorate -40
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- commit ---"
git show --stat --oneline 650dba4
echo "--- diff 650dba4 vs master ---"
git diff --stat master 650dba4
echo "--- parents ---"
git cat-file -p 650dba4 | head -20
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
git merge --no-ff 650dba4 -m "Merge branch 'Move to Stanford' into master"
echo "--- status ---"
git status
echo "--- log ---"
git log --oneline --graph --decorate -6
echo "--- verify files ---"
git diff --stat 650dba4 master
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
git config user.name "Test User"
git config user.email "test@example.com"
git merge --no-ff 650dba4 -m "Move to Stanford"
echo "--- status ---"
git status
echo "--- log ---"
git log --oneline --graph --decorate -6
echo "--- diff vs lost commit (expect empty) ---"
git diff --stat 650dba4 master
echo "--- about.md ---"
git show master:_includes/about.md | head -20
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
echo "--- conflicted file ---"
cat _includes/about.md
echo "--- base (c4e38a1) ---"
git show c4e38a1:_includes/about.md
echo "--- master version (d7d3e4b) ---"
git show d7d3e4b:_includes/about.md
echo "--- lost commit version (650dba4) ---"
git show 650dba4:_includes/about.md
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
git checkout --theirs _includes/about.md
git add _includes/about.md _layouts/default.html
git commit -m "Move to Stanford"
echo "--- status ---"
git status
echo "--- log ---"
git log --oneline --graph --decorate -8
echo "--- diff vs lost commit (expect empty) ---"
git diff --stat 650dba4 master
echo "--- about.md ---"
cat _includes/about.md
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
ls -a
echo "--- layout diff vs lost commit ---"
git diff 650dba4 master -- _layouts/default.html
echo "--- test/build files ---"
ls -1 | grep -Ei 'readme|makefile|gemfile|package.json|test' || true
find . -maxdepth 2 -iname 'readme*' -o -maxdepth 2 -iname 'makefile' -o -maxdepth 2 -iname 'gemfile' 2>/dev/null
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace/personal-site
grep -rn '^<<<<<<<\|^=======$\|^>>>>>>>' --exclude-dir=.git . || echo "no conflict markers"
git status --short
git log --oneline -1
EOF
